parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description:
The page number to return.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: FirewallSwitchStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **opened**: The firewall is enabled.

- **closed**: The firewall is disabled.

- **notconfigured**: The firewall is not configured.

- **configured**: The firewall is configured but is disabled.

> If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls in all states are queried.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of a member account that is managed by your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: NetworkInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions that Cloud Firewall supports, see [Supported regions](~~195657~~).

parameters.name: RouteMode
parameters.description:
The routing mode. Valid values:

- **auto**: automatic mode.

- **manual**: manual mode.

> If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls that use all routing modes are queried.

parameters.name: TransitRouterType
parameters.description:
The type of the transit router. Valid values:

- **Basic**: Basic Edition transit router.

- **Enterprise**: Enterprise Edition transit router.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallName
parameters.description: The instance name of the VPC firewall.
